topic: How Often You Should Get Paid (And Why It Matters More Than You Think)

sections.voiceover: Biweekly pay means every 2 weeks (26 paychecks/year). Semi-monthly means twice a month on fixed dates (24 paychecks/year). They sound identical but the math is completely different.. That number should bother you.

sections.voiceover:
Here's what you're not being told.

Biweekly pay means every 2 weeks (26 paychecks/year). Semi-monthly means twice a month on fixed dates (24 paychecks/year). They sound identical but the math is completely different.

On a $60,000 salary: biweekly paycheck = $2,307.69. Semi-monthly paycheck = $2,500. Same annual total, but the cash flow rhythm is totally different.

This isn't opinion. This is documented. And most people have never seen it.
sections.visual_cue: Background color shifts to #1E293B. Text appears in clean blocks — 3 to 6 words per line, centered. Key terms highlight in #22C55E. No imagery. Text IS the visual.
sections.sfx_cue: Subtle keyboard typing sound as text blocks appear. Low ambient pad. Hard percussive hit on key stat reveal.
sections.transition_out: Text holds for 1 sec, then wipes left. 0.3 sec black.
sections.pacing_notes: Fast and direct. No pauses longer than 0.5 sec. Every sentence is a punch. Energy stays high.

sections.voiceover:
Biweekly pay creates two 'magic third paycheck' months per year. Most people budget for 2 checks/month, so that third check feels like free money — and most people waste it.

2026 is a potential 27-paycheck year for companies whose biweekly cycle starts January 2. That means an extra check worth $2,307.69 on a $60K salary.

Three sources. All independent. All saying the same thing.

sections.pacing_notes: Build momentum through the evidence list. Each point slightly faster than the last. Pause 1 sec after "all saying the same thing" for impact.

sections.voiceover:
So what does this actually mean?

It means the story you've been told is incomplete. The real version is more complicated, more interesting, and more uncomfortable.

And nobody's talking about it.
